purpose: Concept source for the final Reel identity mark
prompt: Design a compact standalone brand mark for a personal media library named Reel. Combine the silhouette logic of a vertical film strip and a subtle bookmark or folded program corner into one ownable geometric symbol. The mark should feel like a projection-booth catalog stamp: editorial, confident, precise, culturally literate, and useful at favicon size. Flat vector-like construction, solid cobalt blue #4F66FF on transparent background, crisp negative-space film perforations, no text, no letters, no play triangle, no camera icon, no book icon, no gradients, no glow, no shadow, no mockup, no border, centered with generous transparent padding. One symbol only. High contrast and legible at 24 px.
